description.ja: 『デジモンアドベンチャー』より、オメガモンがFigure-rise Standard Amplifiedで登場！
description.en: From "Digimon Adventure", Omegamon appears in Figure-rise Standard Amplified!

description.ja: • 原作リスペクトの元、キャラクターの魅力を“増幅”させたAMPLIFIEDシリーズ第1弾！
description.en: • The first installment of the AMPLIFIED series, which respects the original work and amplifies the charm of the characters!

description.ja: • 各パーツの配色を成形色で再現。白いパーツにはグロスインジェクションを採用。
description.en: • The color scheme of each part is reproduced with molded colors. Gloss injection is used for white parts.

description.ja: • オメガモンの魅力を更に際立たせるために、各パーツをシャープ化。
description.en: • In order to further highlight Omegamon's charm, each part has been sharpened.

description.ja: • 腰部の拡張用３mm穴がプラモデルとしての可能性をさらに増幅(AMPLIFIED)。
description.en: • The 3mm expansion hole in the waist area further amplifies its potential as a plastic model (AMPLIFIED).

accessories.ja: アクションベース用接合パーツ×1
accessories.en: Joint parts for action base x 1
